newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Chemical up on good profit report.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Chemical up on good profit report.

text.p: Shares in Nissan Chemical Industries Ltd rose in Tokyo morning trade on Thursday following a newspaper report saying the company may enjoy a record current profit in the year to March 31, brokers said.
As of 0142 GMT, the share was up 34 yen at 578 yen, the fifth biggest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Earlier, the financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbum reported that the company"s parent current profit would grow 19 percent to a record 6.8 billion yen in 1996/97, helped by growing demand for electronics materials and improved earnings due to the yen"s weakness.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
